# WI35 · Tài liệu & hóa đơn · chờ thanh toán

Group **WI · Patient Mobile web** · state · Next.js: **served by KMP/Zalo**

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/patient.js#docs`
- The whole phone web is one script, `shared/patient.js` (an IIFE; page `patient-mobile/index.html` only holds `<div id="app">` and the script tags). Module state: `screen`, `identity`, `group`, `historyLimit` and the send-update drafts. `render()` picks one of `home`, `appointments`, `journey`, `progress`, `care`, `send`, `messages`, `docs`, `profile`; `app(content)` wraps it with the top bar (logo, avatar button "ML" that opens Hồ sơ), `<main class="mobile-content">` and the bottom `<nav class="mobile-nav">`.
- Navigation is data-driven: every `data-screen` button switches screen (and resets the history limit to 3), every `data-action` button calls `action()`. The bottom navigation has five items, "Trang chủ", "Lịch hẹn", "Hành trình", "Tin nhắn", "Hồ sơ". Sub-screens keep a parent item lit: `progress`, `care` and `send` light "Hành trình"; `docs` lights "Hồ sơ" (so WI6, WI7, WI8 and WI9 show a different active item than their back button suggests). Back buttons: "← Trang chủ", "← Hành trình", "← Hồ sơ", "← Chăm sóc tại nhà".
- `shared/care-finance.js › injectMobile` appends the card "Đơn & phiếu đã duyệt" (class `mobile-linked-prescriptions`) under the Trang chủ, Hồ sơ and Tài liệu & hóa đơn screens. It lists only what a doctor approved (prescription, and approved cashier orders with "Đơn thuốc" and "Phiếu tư vấn"); otherwise it shows the chip "Chưa có" and "Đơn và phiếu sẽ xuất hiện sau khi bác sĩ duyệt."
- Data is the demo store `Pema.state` (localStorage, shared with the clinic web of the same origin) and `pema-patient-identity` (the chosen synthetic patient, default P001). A change made in the clinic web shows here on the next render (`pema-external` and `pema-change` events), except while the send or progress screen is open so a draft is never wiped.
- Feedback is a toast only: `showToast(msg)` re-renders with `<div class="mobile-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">` and clears it after 2.8 s (the whole screen is rendered again both times). A failed save (`saveOrRollback`) restores the state and toasts "Không lưu được thay đổi. Dữ liệu và bản nháp vẫn được giữ lại."
- `docs()` for P002: one paid invoice "Buổi chăm sóc / điều trị HD-0002 · 2026-09-06 · Đã thanh toán 1.500.000 ₫" and "Tư vấn da liễu HD-DEMO-002 · 2026-09-20 · Chờ thanh toán 500.000 ₫".
- Inventory note: P002: one paid invoice and one "Chờ thanh toán" invoice (WI9 shows paid and "Đã thu một phần · còn …").
- Patient Mobile has no staff account: it does not load `staff-context.js`, no capability removes a control, and the patient is a synthetic profile (localStorage `pema-patient-identity`). Reaches that start in the clinic web (creating a profile, recording a CSKH task, approving an order) run as `owner-tam` only to prepare the data.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/patient-mobile/"} → {"wait":".mobile-app"} → {"click":".mobile-nav [data-screen=\"profile\"]"} → {"select":["#identity-select","P002"]} → {"gone":".mobile-toast"} → {"click":".doc-row[data-screen=\"docs\"]"}; it must show "Chờ thanh toán".

Kit components used: Card×3, Button×2, Badge×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- There is no native browser dialog (`confirm`, `prompt`, `alert`) in the phone web (checked in `patient.js` and `index.html`): every message is a toast or an inline line, so no id of this group needs a captured native text.
- "Chờ thanh toán" is shown for an invoice with nothing received.

## Differences from the app design
- App G7 opens with the heading "Khoản cần thanh toán" and a hero with the amount still to pay ("580.000 ₫", "Đã thu 0 ₫"); the web has no total, only the status text of each invoice ("Chờ thanh toán").

## Gotchas
- Primary frame is 390×844. From 701px up, `.mobile-app` is a 460px column (max-width) of 100dvh with a scrolling `.mobile-content` and the bottom navigation inside the column, so the 1440×900 snapshot shows the column at x 490 and the probes at 1920, 1280, 1024 and 390 report "no layout change". What the probes cannot see changes at ≤700px (design.css): content padding 20px, top bar padding 22px 20px, `.mobile-heading` 28px, `.mobile-card` padding 18px, logo 112px; at max-height 740px the home cards compact (heading 22-23px, quick-action captions hidden); at ≤370px the nav font is 10px.
- Every screen has the same frame (top bar, content, bottom navigation, and the toast when one is up), so the ids differ only in the content. The snapshot scope is `body`.
- Icon glyphs typed as characters in the code (✓ ✦ ⚙ ▤ ▧ ＋ › ▢) are swapped for lucide icons at render (`PemaUI.enhance`) and are not part of the labels in the snapshot (the label of "＋ Gửi tin nhắn" is "Gửi tin nhắn"); the web canvas draws icons from the kit.
- Accessible names that are not visible text: the avatar button "Mở hồ sơ demo của <tên>", the session rail "<n> trên <total> buổi hoàn tất", the progress bar "Số buổi điều trị đã hoàn tất", the quick action "Xem hướng dẫn", the faces "Trước — minh họa tổng hợp, không phải ảnh bệnh nhân" and "Gần nhất — …", the file input "Ảnh cập nhật cho Pema", the consent box "Đồng ý để Pema xem ảnh cập nhật" and the preview "Xem trước ảnh cập nhật" (alt "Ảnh cập nhật đã chọn — bản demo").
- Patient data is the synthetic store (46 patients; the default profile is P001, phone masked as "09•• ••• 100"). Screens of a toast (WI23, WI28, WI29, WI31, WI33, WI34, WI38-WI40) are captured while the toast is up (2.8 s) and list it as a `notice` with role "status".
- At 390 the amount column of an invoice row is narrow: the currency sign wraps under the number ("720.500" / "₫"). It is how the old web looks; keep it unless the owner decides otherwise.
